شَاطٌّ Anything Distant, remote, or far. (TA.) ―
-b2- A man whose two extremities are far from each other. (K.) ―
-b3- جَارِيَةٌ شَاطَّةٌ, (S, K,) and ↓ شَطَّةٌ , (K,) A girl tall, and of beautiful stature: (K:) or of just stature. (S, K.) ＝
-A2- إِنَّكَ لَشَاطِّى Verily thou art acting unjustly, wrongfully, injuriously, or tyrannically, towards me in judging: occurring in a trad. (A'Obeyd, Az, S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
